_comment: Read by main.js. Later chunks edit this file: set status, add numbers (each with the script that produced it), and set figures[].src to an image under site/results/ once analysis/ has produced it. Never type a number here that did not come from a script.

status.headline: Chunk 1 in progress · environment setup
status.note: No experiment has run. Chunk 1 (environment) is in progress; cloud prep is done and verification on the laptop is pending. The first measurements arrive with Chunk 2, the reordering gate.

figures.title: Goodput around a single reroute
figures.caption: Elephant goodput versus time, aligned on the FLOW_MOD, slow-to-fast and fast-to-slow, two delay gaps, 10 repetitions each, against a no-reroute control.

figures.title: Damage per move at the gate
figures.caption: Spurious retransmissions, reorder events and goodput deficit per move with 95% CIs. Pass criterion is pre-registered in LOG.md before the first run.

figures.title: ECMP spreading across spines
figures.caption: Bytes per select-group bucket from dump-group-stats, showing how often elephants collide under hashing.

figures.title: Elephant throughput: ECMP vs Hedera-style vs cooldown-only
figures.caption: 10 paired runs on the same seeds, mean with 95% CI.

figures.title: Short-flow completion time, p50 and p99
figures.caption: Reported per spine class on the delay-asymmetric topology.

figures.title: Reroutes, flaps and retransmissions per policy
figures.caption: The damage side of the trade-off. Hedera-style is expected to pay here; ECMP pays nothing.

figures.title: Which features predict damage
figures.caption: Feature-versus-damage correlation across the deliberate-reroute campaign, with row count and scenario ids.

figures.title: Prediction error on held-out scenarios
figures.caption: MAE of the tree and gradient-boosting models against predict-the-mean and the hand-written formula, plus decision time per flow.

figures.title: Five-way comparison
figures.caption: Gain kept versus damage caused for ECMP, Hedera-style, cooldown-only, formula and ML controllers.
